decisions.rationale: _airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and are capture-tool columns, not business data.
id has null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 9057 equal to row_count 9057, making it the only column that plausibly identifies one row after cleanup.
dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 9057, so no exact duplicate rows were observed and no dedupe strategy is required.
id samples ('10309','1058','111', etc.) are all numeric strings with null_rate 0.0, supporting a strict cast from VARCHAR to INTEGER.
elevation_ft samples (-1266.0, -210.0, -182.0, ...) are all whole-number values despite the DECIMAL(38,9) landed type, so the column is renamed elevation_feet and cast to INTEGER.
scheduled_service has exactly two distinct_values ('no','yes') with null_rate 0.0, supporting a boolean cast renamed is_scheduled_service.
continent is a code column per the data dictionary; renamed to continent_code to follow the _code naming convention, preserving that 'NA' means North America.
latitude_deg and longitude_deg were renamed to latitude_degrees and longitude_degrees to spell out the abbreviated unit per the measure-naming convention.
local_code has null_rate 63.664% (5766 of 9057 nulls), the highest among code columns, and is retained nullable rather than imputed.
home_link has null_rate 74.903% (6784 of 9057 nulls) and is retained nullable rather than imputed.

purpose: silver_airports provides one cleaned, typed row per airport sourced from the OurAirports public-domain dataset (every airport carrying an IATA code), feeding downstream airport reference, lookup, and geospatial mapping use cases.
usage: Join on id as the stable integer grain key (iata_code is also unique in this extract and may serve as a natural key); latitude_degrees and longitude_degrees are decimal degrees with north and east positive; elevation_feet, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, keywords, and municipality can be null and consumers must filter or handle nulls deliberately rather than assume completeness; continent_code 'NA' means North America and iso_country 'NA' means Namibia, both values rather than missing markers.
limitations: duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 so no dedupe was applied and none is needed; local_code (63.66% null), home_link (74.90% null), and keywords (67.96% null) remain sparsely populated and were not imputed; icao_code (13.66% null) and wikipedia_link (13.08% null) also carry nontrivial null rates that consumers must account for explicitly.
